crossRefs.note: Yahweh God caused the man to fall into a deep sleep. As the man slept, he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh…
Yahweh God made a woman from the rib which he had taken from the man, and brought her to the man.
For Adam was formed first, then Eve.

translations.web: For man is not from woman, but woman from man;
translations.bsb: For man did not come from woman, but woman from man.
translations.kjv: For the man is not of the woman; but the woman of the man.
translations.asv: For the man is not of the woman; but the woman of the man:
